item.title: Ava DuVernay’s ARRAY Unveils 2025 ARRAY 360 Cinema Series – ARRAY NOW
item.description: Ava DuVernay’s ARRAY, the Peabody Award-winning narrative change collective, has announced the lineup for its annual ARRAY 360 cinema and conversation series, a six-week program of screenings and dialogues that spotlight global voices and intergenerational storytelling.

item.title: HAPPENING @ ARRAY – ARRAY NOW
item.description: ARRAY’s spring 2026 programs interrogate the American dream through the lens of women, centering Black, Indigenous and Latina storytellers as part of a year-long reflection on the 250th anniversary of the United States. Our monthly film series features work by Zeinabu irene Davis, Valerie Red-Horse Mohl and Patricia Riggen, plus films from Brittany Shyne, the People’s Kitchen Collective and Sylvia Morales alongside Ava DuVernay’s QUEEN SUGAR.
